text.p: BLANTRYE, Sept 23 (reuter) - These are the leading stories in the Malawi press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Main opposition Malawi Congress Party (MCP) vice president Gwanda Chakuamba has promised he will provide details of corruption in the Bakili Muluzi government and is ready to give information to the newly established Anti-Corruption Bureau.

- Bilateral duty free trade between Malawi and Zambia could become a solution for illegal cross border trade currently in the increase, said Malawi minister of State Joseph Kubwalo when he officiated a trade expoition in Zambia's Chipata district.
